# Lens dirt

Smudges, dust and rings on the lens that only show where bright light spreads across them, like a dirty camera pointed at the sun.

<EffectDemo effect="lens-dirt" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { lensDirt } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/lens-dirt';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(lensDirt({ preset: 'dusty' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 2`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Range   | Description                                           |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number  | `2`     | 0 – 8   | Brightness of the lit dirt.                           |
| `threshold` | number  | `0.9`   | 0 – 8   | Linear brightness above which light catches the dirt. |
| `knee`      | number  | `0.5`   | 0 – 1   | Softness of the threshold.                            |
| `radius`    | number  | `0.85`  | 0 – 1   | How far light spreads across the lens.                |
| `levels`    | integer | `6`     | 3 – 8   | Blur levels of the light that catches the dirt.       |
| `scale`     | number  | `1`     | 0.3 – 3 | Size of the smudges and specks.                       |
| `seed`      | number  | `0`     | 0 – 100 | Picks a different pattern of dirt.                    |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                         |
| --------- | -------------------------------- |
| `dusty`   | `scale: 0.6`, `intensity: 2.5`   |
| `smudged` | `scale: 2`, `intensity: 1.5`     |
| `bright`  | `intensity: 5`, `threshold: 0.6` |
| `clean`   | `intensity: 0.8`                 |

Apply one with `lensDirt({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 93.5 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 8.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/lens-dirt`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Procedural lens dirt lit by the bloom chain, as in common lens-dirt bloom techniques.
